LESSON: SORTING & GROUPING

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: CLASSIFICATION
Topic 1.1: Sorting & grouping

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Sorting & grouping. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. enjoy sorting and • Learners relate specific attributes grouping objects in the to other objects in the environment environment
2. group objects according • Learners to sing songs related to to a specific attribute to sorting and grouping objects. create sets of similar • Learners to collect and store objects materials in their respective
3. appreciate the materials corners. in the environment for •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: SORTING & GROUPING
Sorting & grouping is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Sorting & grouping problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Sorting & grouping question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Sorting & grouping question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Sorting & grouping set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Sorting & grouping.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Sorting & grouping in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER
